description.value: Parlour Ice Cream is a premium handcrafted ice cream shop that opened in 2017 in downtown Kelowna, obsessing over locally-sourced ingredients like Okanagan Spirits whisky, Kelowna lavender, and local Bean Scene espresso. The shop is known for its fresh house-made waffle cones, rotating seasonal flavours, and a dedicated vegan lineup. With a second Kelowna outpost at Gyro Beach, cyclists riding the lakeshore can easily work a scoop into their route.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: lockers (secure) at 23m; lockers (secure) at 25m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms all OSM contact details (address, phone, website). Vegan and gluten-free options are explicitly listed on the flavours page. Takeout is confirmed via pint orders, cups to go, and food delivery partnerships. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site.
concerns: The business has a second Kelowna location at 3405 Lakeshore Rd (Gyro Beach) and a Calgary location; if those addresses exist as separate OSM nodes they should each have their own listing rather than being merged under this record.
Bike parking, washrooms, and water refill are not addressed anywhere on the website and could not be confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established ice cream shop on Abbott Street in downtown Kelowna — a natural stop on the popular lakeshore cycling corridor — with vegan and GF options suited to a range of cyclists.

Packed lunches.detail: Ice cream shop only; no food items consistent with packed lunches mentioned

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple vegan options listed (coconut/cashew cream base); the majority of flavours are explicitly labelled gluten free; some items also tagged Vegetarian on the flavours page
